entities.summary: Princess Mathilde of Bavaria was the sixth child of Ludwig III of Bavaria and Maria Theresa of Austria-Este. After her early death, Life-Dreams: The Poems of a Blighted Life, a collection of poems she wrote, was published in 1910.
